ns2:section.sectionText: In this service-learning course, students will help teachers in elementary and/or middle schools to teach various IT concepts. In addition, students will learn to program in the Etoys environment, and help teach Etoys programming to sixth-grade students. The course will have a single 2-hour meeting each week with the instructor, plus one or two meetings in the classroom. Students wishing to take this course for only 1 credit hour should contact the instructor.
